subsegment: Municipal water/wastewater treatment plant upgrade (10-80 MGD)
description: Brownfield modernisation or expansion of a municipal WTP/WWTP including biological treatment, filtration, disinfection, and SCADA. Delivered against consent decree or NPDES schedules with tight tie-in windows on a live plant.
hard_deadline_themes: EPA LT2 or DBP rule compliance deadlines

typical_risks.description_template: {tech_pkg} package is sole-sourced via {oem} with {weeks}-week lead time and pre-purchase exposure.
EPA/state consent decree imposes hard placed-in-service date with stipulated penalties of ${k}k/day.
Record drawings inaccurate for brownfield site; yard piping conflicts likely during excavation.
Specialty process mechanical and instrument crews competing with peer water projects in {region}.
Tie-ins to active basins require coordinated bypass with peak-flow season constraint.
Heavy rainfall events overwhelm temporary bypass capacity, suspending tie-in work.
New EPA PFAS MCLs may require scope addition for GAC or IX polishing post-NTP.
Client operations staff turnover risks delayed acceptance testing and beneficial use.

typical_issues.description_template: Excavation struck unmapped {utility_type} requiring emergency repair.
Wet weather event exceeded temporary bypass capacity, triggering SSO notification.
Basin leak test failed; epoxy injection repair required.
Membrane skids failed initial FAT, requiring vendor rework before shipping.
Legacy PLC integration revealed protocol mismatches delaying functional testing.
Asbestos pipe insulation discovered during demolition of original works.
State agency added supplemental sampling requirement mid-construction.
Chlorine residual targets not met during startup; recirculation extended.
Utility outage exceeded planned window, damaging in-service drives.

typical_co_drivers: PFAS treatment addition per evolving regulation
Additional bypass pumping for wet-weather events
